🧸✨[b] Chloe’s Cannele Outfit Pack2.0[/b] ✨🧸₊˚ෆ⊹₊ 

This mod introduces a cute Cannele fashion set, including:
💕 5 hairstyles & 5 shirts & 5 pants & 4 hats & 1 accessory.   

[b]24 Oct update notes: 
[/b]Hi everyone, ﻿here’s some updates for my Cannele outfit pack(2.0.0)~[list=1]
[*]Redrew the hairstyles' side view to make them look more natural.
[*][b]Added 3 new hats[/b] — two pairs of cannele hair clips and one pair of colorful clips.
[*][b]Added a new accessory[/b]: Heart-shaped [i]Choc bag[/i].
[*]Completely[b] redesigned the second hairstyle[/b].
[*]Adjusted hair height to fit most of [i]Delloti’s[/i] hats.
[/list]﻿-------------------------------[color=#d5a6bd][b]HOW TO USE:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Install Fashion Sense: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969[/url]
[*]Buy the Hand Mirror from Pierre’s shop.
[*]Select the Hand Mirror in your toolbar and left-click your character to open the outfit menu.
[*]Use the icons to switch categories:
[/list][list=1]
[*]Left (top → bottom): Hair ✂️/ Accessory🕶️ / Hat👒 / Body👩🏻‍🦲
[*]Right (top → bottom): Top👚 / Bottom👖 / Sleeves🧤 / Shoes👟
[/list][list]
[*]Click the item icon and 🔍 search bar, then type the item you want to wear💖
[*]Note: If the color doesn’t match the preview, try setting the base color to 0 / 0 / 100.
[/list]------
